units.title: HEALTH AND SAFETY STANDARDS AND REGULATORY COMPLIANCE.

learning_outcomes.description: Understand Occupational Health and Safety Regulations

performance_criteria.description: Describe the key OHS principles governing home automation and IoT installations.
Identify specific national and international OHS regulations applicable to electrical and smart device installations.
Explain the legal responsibilities of employers and workers under occupational safety laws in the home automation industry.

learning_outcomes.description: Apply Safety Practices in the Workplace

performance_criteria.description: Demonstrate the proper use of personal protective equipment (PPE) such as gloves, goggles, and insulated tools during installations.
Implement safe working procedures for handling and installing electrical components in home automation systems.
Inspect the work area for potential hazards, ensuring compliance with safety protocols before starting any installation.

learning_outcomes.description: Identify and Assess Workplace Hazards

performance_criteria.description: Conduct a risk assessment for a home automation installation site, identifying potential electrical, fire, and ergonomic hazards.
Evaluate the severity and likelihood of hazards identified during risk assessments to prioritize corrective actions.
Apply control measures such as grounding, insulation, and safety barriers to mitigate risks identified in the work environment.

learning_outcomes.description: Ensure Safe Installation of Home Automation and IoT Devices

performance_criteria.description: Follow safety guidelines when installing IoT devices to ensure proper insulation and protection against electrical surges.
Mount home automation equipment, such as hubs and smart sensors, in safe, non-hazardous locations.
Test the installed equipment to ensure that all safety mechanisms (e.g., circuit breakers, surge protectors) are functional and compliant with OHS standards.

learning_outcomes.description: Comply with Legal and Ethical Obligations

performance_criteria.description: Verify that all installed devices and systems comply with local and international health and safety regulations.
Ensure adherence to electrical codes, such as wiring standards and safe installation practices.
Demonstrate ethical responsibility by maintaining a safe working environment that protects the health and safety of all individuals on-site.

learning_outcomes.description: Maintain Documentation and Records

performance_criteria.description: Document safety checks for all home automation and IoT installations.
Prepare a report detailing the risk assessments conducted.
Record incidents or near-miss events in the workplace, ensuring they are logged for future safety audits and improvements.

learning_outcomes.description: Know the Importance of Teamwork in Home Automation Projects

performance_criteria.description: Explain the role of teamwork in successfully completing home automation installations
Identify the benefits of collaborative work, such as efficiency, innovation, and problem-solving.
Describe how different team members' roles contribute to the overall success of a project.

learning_outcomes.description: Contribute Effectively to a Team

performance_criteria.description: Participate actively in team meetings
Offer support and assistance to team members when needed.
Complete assigned tasks within the agreed-upon timeframe.

learning_outcomes.description: Solve Problems Collaboratively

performance_criteria.description: Discuss potential challenges encountered during a home automation project with the team.
Work together with team members to troubleshoot issues.
Identify innovative solutions for optimizing the installation of home automation systems.

learning_outcomes.description: Manage Conflict and Resolve Disagreements in a Team

performance_criteria.description: Recognize the causes of conflict in team environments and their potential impact on home automation project outcomes.
Address conflicts directly and professionally.
Apply conflict resolution strategies.

units.title: COMMUNICATION IN HOME AUTOMATION AND IOT

learning_outcomes.description: Communicate Technical Information Effectively

performance_criteria.description: Explain the functionality of home automation devices and IoT systems to clients in non-technical language to ensure clear understanding.
Prepare technical documentation, such as installation guides and system specifications, which is concise and easy to follow for both technical and non-technical users.
Demonstrate how to troubleshoot common technical issues using clear, step-by-step verbal or written instructions to guide clients or colleagues.

learning_outcomes.description: Collaborate Effectively with Team Members

performance_criteria.description: Use appropriate communication platforms (e.g., email, project management tools) to share updates, instructions, and progress reports with team members in real-time.
Listen actively during team discussions to fully understand and address the concerns or input of other team members.
Clarify technical instructions given by colleagues, asking follow-up questions.

learning_outcomes.description: Interact Professionally with Clients and Stakeholders

performance_criteria.description: Conduct client consultations to gather project requirements and communicate possible solutions.
Present project updates, timelines, and system performance reports to clients
Respond to client inquiries promptly.

units.title: INTRODUCTION TO HOME AUTOMATION AND IoT

learning_outcomes.description: Know the Fundamentals of Home Automation and IoT

performance_criteria.description: Describe the key concepts of home automation and IoT.
Identify the core components of a typical home automation system, such as sensors, controllers, and network devices.
Explain how IoT devices communicate and interact with each other

learning_outcomes.description: Recognize the Applications and Benefits of Home Automation and IoT

performance_criteria.description: List common applications of home automation systems, such as lighting control, security systems, and energy management.
Illustrate how home automation can enhance energy efficiency, convenience, and security in residential environments.
Discuss the potential benefits and challenges of IoT integration in modern homes, including privacy and data security concerns.

learning_outcomes.description: Explore Emerging Trends and Technologies in Home Automation and IoT

performance_criteria.description: Research the latest advancements in IoT technologies, such as smart speakers, voice assistants, and AI integration.
Identify upcoming trends in home automation, including interoperability standards, smart energy solutions, and automation in everyday appliances.
Analyse how new technologies, like 5G and edge computing, are impacting the development and expansion of home automation systems.

learning_outcomes.description: Understand the Networking Requirements for Home Automation Systems

performance_criteria.description: Identify the types of networks commonly used in home automation systems.
Describe the role of gateways in facilitating communication between IoT devices.
Explain the importance of reliable and secure networking of IoT devices in smart homes.

learning_outcomes.description: Know the Basic Networking Concepts and Terminology

performance_criteria.description: Define key networking terms, such as IP address, router, gateway, LAN, WAN, and subnet.
Explain the role of network components in home automation networks.
Identify the differences between wired and wireless networks and their application in home automation systems.

learning_outcomes.description: Know Network Protocols Relevant to Home Automation

performance_criteria.description: Describe commonly used communication protocols in home automation, including Wi-Fi, Zigbee, Z-Wave, and Bluetooth.
Compare the advantages and disadvantages of different network protocols for specific smart home devices (e.g., security cameras, thermostats, lighting).
Explain the importance of the Transmission Control Protocol/Internet Protocol (TCP/IP) in facilitating data transmission between IoT devices.

learning_outcomes.description: Set Up and Configure a Home Automation Network

performance_criteria.description: Configure a wireless router to serve as the central hub for a home automation network.
Connect multiple IoT devices to the network
Configure device settings and network parameters, such as SSID, encryption, and IP addressing, to optimize performance and security.

learning_outcomes.description: Optimize Network Performance for Home Automation Systems

performance_criteria.description: Measure network performance metrics, such as bandwidth, latency, and signal strength, using appropriate diagnostic tools.
Adjust network settings, including channel selection, device prioritization (QoS), and bandwidth allocation, to improve overall system performance.
Implement network management tools to monitor network stability and performance over time.

learning_outcomes.description: Know the Role of Cloud Services in Home Automation Networks

performance_criteria.description: Explain how cloud services are integrated into home automation networks
Connect IoT devices to cloud-based platforms, enabling remote access and control through mobile apps or web interfaces.
Analyse the benefits and potential risks of using cloud services, including data privacy, reliability, and service costs.

units.title: INSTALLATION AND CONFIGURATION OF HOME AUTOMATION SYSTEMS

learning_outcomes.description: Explain the Components and Architecture of Home Automation Systems

performance_criteria.description: Explain the key components of a home automation system, such as controllers, sensors, actuators, and hubs.
Explain the role of communication protocols (e.g., Zigbee, Z-Wave, Wi-Fi) in connecting and controlling home automation devices.
Describe how various subsystems, such as lighting, HVAC, and security, interact within a smart home environment.

learning_outcomes.description: Install Home Automation Devices and Components

performance_criteria.description: Install basic home automation devices, such as smart thermostats, lights, or cameras, following manufacturer guidelines.
Position sensors and smart devices in optimal locations to ensure maximum efficiency and coverage in the home.
Connect devices to the central hub or controller and verify that they are powered and communicating with the network.

learning_outcomes.description: Configure Home Automation Systems

performance_criteria.description: Configure device settings (e.g., schedules, preferences, triggers) using a smartphone app, desktop software, or control panel.
Integrate devices into a unified system, enabling communication between different subsystems, such as lighting and security.
Test the configuration by activating devices and verifying that they respond correctly to commands and automation rules.

learning_outcomes.description: Ensure System Security and Privacy

performance_criteria.description: Implement security measures, such as encryption and strong passwords, to protect home automation devices and networks from unauthorized access.
Enable security features such as two-factor authentication (2FA) and device monitoring to enhance system protection.
Monitor system logs for suspicious activity and take steps to secure vulnerable devices or settings.

learning_outcomes.description: Perform System Testing and Quality Assurance

performance_criteria.description: Test all installed devices to ensure they respond properly to user commands and automation rules and are integrated with other systems.
Conduct functional tests for automation scenarios, such as turning lights on when motion is detected or adjusting temperature based on time.
Verify that the system is operating within performance specifications, ensuring all devices work without delay or errors.

learning_outcomes.description: Provide User Training and Support

performance_criteria.description: Explain system functionality and user controls to clients, demonstrating how to operate and customize their home automation system.
Provide documentation or user manuals that outline system features, troubleshooting steps, and maintenance tips.
Respond to client inquiries or issues post-installation, offering support and guidance on system use and optimization.

units.title: TROUBLESHOOTING HOME AUTOMATION AND IOT DEVICES

learning_outcomes.description: Identify Common Issues in Home Automation and IoT Devices

performance_criteria.description: List the common technical issues encountered in home automation devices, such as connectivity problems, sensor malfunctions, and power failures.
Recognize common symptoms of device malfunction, such as unresponsiveness, delays, or incorrect system behavior.
Categorize issues based on their origin, such as hardware faults, software glitches, or network connectivity issues.

learning_outcomes.description: Diagnose Connectivity Problems in IoT Devices

performance_criteria.description: Analyse network-related issues by checking Wi-Fi signal strength, interference, and router configuration settings.
Test the communication between IoT devices and the central hub or cloud service, ensuring they are properly connected.
Verify that device firmware and software versions are up to date to ensure compatibility with the home network and other devices.

learning_outcomes.description: Resolve Device Configuration and Integration Issues

performance_criteria.description: Reset devices to factory settings when necessary to resolve configuration conflicts and reconnect them to the home network.
Reconfigure device settings, such as IP addresses, network credentials, and automation rules, to resolve integration problems.
Update devices with the latest firmware and ensure that they are correctly paired with compatible hubs or controllers.

learning_outcomes.description: Troubleshoot Power and Hardware Issues

performance_criteria.description: Inspect power supplies and batteries to identify issues such as depleted batteries, loose connections, or faulty power adapters.
Replace defective hardware components like sensors, actuators, or cables to restore device functionality.
Test device circuits and power outputs to ensure all components are receiving adequate power for optimal operation.

learning_outcomes.description: Monitor and Analyse System Logs and Diagnostics

performance_criteria.description: Access system logs on devices or cloud platforms to monitor errors, warnings, and abnormal activities that indicate system issues.
Interpret diagnostic reports generated by smart devices or network management tools to identify potential causes of malfunctions.
Document the steps and findings from the troubleshooting process to ensure a clear record for future reference or further analysis.

learning_outcomes.description: Know the Principles of System Integration and Interoperability

performance_criteria.description: Define key concepts related to system integration and interoperability, including protocols, APIs, and standards.
Explain the importance of integration in home automation, highlighting benefits such as enhanced functionality and user experience.
Identify common integration challenges and compatibility issues between different devices and systems.

learning_outcomes.description: Evaluate Device and System Compatibility

performance_criteria.description: Review device specifications and documentation to determine compatibility with existing home automation systems and protocols.
Compare integration options for devices that use different communication protocols, such as Zigbee, Z-Wave, and Wi-Fi.
Test interoperability between devices from different manufacturers to ensure they function together as intended.

learning_outcomes.description: Configure and Implement Integration Solutions

performance_criteria.description: Set up and configure a central hub or gateway to manage and control multiple home automation devices from different protocols.
Integrate devices into a unified system using available APIs or third-party platforms, ensuring that they can communicate and interact effectively.
Configure automation rules and scenarios that involve multiple devices, ensuring that actions and triggers work seamlessly across the system.
Verify integration by conducting tests to ensure that devices respond correctly to commands and automation rules.

learning_outcomes.description: Troubleshoot Integration and Interoperability Issues

performance_criteria.description: Identify integration issues, such as devices not responding or conflicting automation rules, by analysing system behaviour and logs.
Resolve interoperability problems by adjusting device settings, reconfiguring the central hub, or updating firmware/software as needed.
Document the troubleshooting process and solutions applied to address integration issues, creating a reference for future problems.
Test the system after troubleshooting to ensure that integration issues have been resolved and that the devices function correctly.

learning_outcomes.description: Ensure Data Consistency and Synchronization Across Systems

performance_criteria.description: Monitor data exchange between integrated systems to ensure that information, such as device status and user settings, is synchronized accurately.
Implement data consistency checks and error handling procedures to address discrepancies or conflicts between systems.
Configure data synchronization settings to ensure that changes in one system are reflected across all integrated devices and platforms.
